localized.zh_cn: 跨维度红晶信号已修正：移除电源后，镜间反馈不再自行维持供电。
localized.en_us: Cross-dimensional redcrystal is fixed: mirror feedback no longer sustains power after its source is removed.

localized.zh_cn: 红晶网络适配新版：仅检查已加载区块，每个相连网络最多处理 16384 个节点。
localized.en_us: Redcrystal networks use loaded chunks only and process at most 16384 connected nodes.

localized.zh_cn: 炼金锅炉新增自动化：顶部可用漏斗送入燃料、空桶，并取出容器余物。
localized.en_us: Alchemical boilers support automation: the top item interface accepts fuel and empty buckets and exposes container remainders.

localized.zh_cn: 易物箱交换已修正：接收方放不下的物品留在原处；玩家改名后仍保留原有识别关系。
localized.en_us: Eager Chest trading is fixed: rejected items stay at their source, and player recognition survives name changes.

localized.zh_cn: 贪婪珍珠回收已调整：飞行时不占用原槽，返回时优先放回空原槽，再放入背包；没有空间才掉落。
localized.en_us: Avarice pearls no longer reserve their original slot while flying. On return they use that slot if empty, then inventory space, otherwise drop.

localized.zh_cn: 筛选纸适配新版：忽略损伤不会合并不同注册物品；旧版共用数据值的变种可能需要分别指定。
localized.en_us: Filters use modern item identities: ignoring damage does not merge distinct items; former metadata variants may need separate entries.

localized.zh_cn: 库存统计已修正：双箱等同一库存不会因从不同面访问而重复计数。
localized.en_us: Inventarium counts are fixed: accessing the same inventory, including double chests, from multiple faces no longer counts it twice.
